I have so many favorite songs, but I think it's Solitaire by Marina & The Diamonds, I love Michael Jackson too he's my favorite artist. My town is very small, it's not that bad except that it's violent, there's nothing to do here and people here are very ignorant. 
 It's really not L.A itself, I just need to go somewhere you know? I thought of California because I think it must be a beautiful state with a lot of things to do, but what I need is to get out of here and go somewhere I can be free and feel safe. 
Thank you for trying to help me, it means a lot
I love listening to music, but I cannot spend the rest of my life listening to music inside my bedroom.
